tasks.label: build
tasks.detail: Full build: transformer → types → eastwind server + client.

tasks.label: build eastwind
tasks.detail: Builds the eastwind app layers (data + server + client) and their altea deps. preLaunchTask for the API server debug configs.

tasks.label: build eastwind terminal
tasks.detail: Builds the eastwind terminal layer (CLI host + loaders; references data + server). preLaunchTask for the terminal debug configs.

tasks.label: watch types
tasks.detail: tspc -b --watch over eastwind and the altea layers it references — keeps emitted JS fresh for vite dev. Does NOT build any package's test/ layer; for that run 'watch types (altea suites)'.

tasks.label: watch types (altea suites)
tasks.detail: tspc -b --watch inside @altea/altea, whose solution DOES reference tsconfig.test.json — so the compiled suites the Test Explorer runs stay fresh as you edit. Working in another package? Point this task's cwd at it.

tasks.label: dev (eastwind)
tasks.detail: Runs eastwind types + server + client watchers together.

tasks.label: build eastwind server bundle
tasks.detail: Bundles transformer-emitted logic JS into one runnable file (used by the server debugger).

tasks.label: build quote-transformer
tasks.detail: Compiles the ts-patch transformer itself (altea/quote-transformer -> dist).

tasks.label: build quote-transformer-test
tasks.detail: Compiles the transformer's own test package (and the transformer it loads), so the Test Explorer runs current output.

tasks.label: build @altea/altea test (tspc -b)
tasks.detail: Compiles @altea/altea (framework + its internalized test/ suite) to dist; preLaunchTask for the generate-DB debug config. Skip the wait by running 'watch types (altea suites)' instead.

tasks.label: eastwind full stack — local
tasks.detail: Build types, then run the API server (.env.local) + vite client + tspc watch together (pnpm stack local). Open http://localhost:5173.

tasks.label: eastwind full stack — dev
tasks.detail: Build types, then run the API server (.env.dev) + vite client + tspc watch together (pnpm stack dev). Open http://localhost:5173.
